title: State Bank of India SBI Junior Associates Clerk Recruitment 2026 : New Exam Date for 9124 Post
vacancyDetails: 9124 SBI Junior Associates Clerk vacancies: 7680 regular posts and 1444 backlog posts.
qualification: Bachelor's degree in any discipline from a recognized university in India; local language requirements apply as per the concerned state or circle.
ageLimit: Minimum age 20 years and maximum age 28 years as on 01/04/2026. Age relaxation as per SBI rules.
selectionProcess: Preliminary Examination → Main Examination → Local Language Test / Document Verification → Final Selection
documentsRequired: Registration number or roll number, password or date of birth, printed call letter and valid photo ID.
howToApply: Visit the official SBI Careers or IBPS portal, open the Junior Associates Clerk admit-card link when activated, enter your credentials and download the call letter.
shortDescription: SBI Junior Associates Clerk Recruitment 2026 new exam date update for 9124 posts. Admit card will be available before the examination through the official SBI or IBPS portal.
content:
State Bank of India has released an update for the Junior Associates Clerk Recruitment 2026 for 9124 posts.

Candidates should check the official SBI Careers page for the new examination schedule and download the admit card when the call-letter link is activated.

Important Dates

  • Application Begin: 11/08/2026
  • Last Date for Apply Online: 31/08/2026
  • Phase I Preliminary Exam: 26 to 27 September 2026
  • Admit Card: Before Exam
  • Phase II Main Exam: As per Schedule

Application Fee

  • General / EWS / OBC: 750/-
  • SC / ST / PH: 0/-
